__inputs.name: DS_PROMETHEUS
__inputs.label: Prometheus
__inputs.description: Prometheus data source with MongoDB metrics

targets.expr:
sum  by(pod) (rate(mongodb_opcounters_command{pod=~"$Replica"}[$__rate_interval]))
+
sum  by(pod) (rate(mongodb_opcounters_delete{pod=~"$Replica"}[$__rate_interval]))
+
sum  by(pod) (rate(mongodb_opcounters_getmore{pod=~"$Replica"}[$__rate_interval]))
+
sum  by(pod) (rate(mongodb_opcounters_insert{pod=~"$Replica"}[$__rate_interval]))
+
sum  by(pod) (rate(mongodb_opcounters_query{pod=~"$Replica"}[$__rate_interval]))
+
sum  by(pod) (rate(mongodb_opcounters_update{pod=~"$Replica"}[$__rate_interval]))

sum by(pod) (rate(mongodb_metrics_document_deleted{pod=~"$Replica"}[$__rate_interval]))
+
sum by(pod) (rate(mongodb_metrics_document_inserted{pod=~"$Replica"}[$__rate_interval]))
+
sum by(pod) (rate(mongodb_metrics_document_returned{pod=~"$Replica"}[$__rate_interval]))
+
sum by(pod) (rate(mongodb_metrics_document_updated{pod=~"$Replica"}[$__rate_interval]))

sum by(pod) (rate(mongodb_metrics_queryExecutor_collectionScans_nonTailable{pod=~"$Replica"}[$__rate_interval]))
+
sum by(pod) (rate(mongodb_metrics_queryExecutor_collectionScans_total{pod=~"$Replica"}[$__rate_interval]))
+
sum by(pod) (rate(mongodb_metrics_queryExecutor_profiler_collectionScans_nonTailable{pod=~"$Replica"}[$__rate_interval]))
+
sum by(pod) (rate(mongodb_metrics_queryExecutor_profiler_collectionScans_tailable{pod=~"$Replica"}[$__rate_interval]))
+
sum by(pod) (rate(mongodb_metrics_queryExecutor_profiler_collectionScans_total{pod=~"$Replica"}[$__rate_interval]))
+
sum by(pod) (rate(mongodb_metrics_queryExecutor_scanned{pod=~"$Replica"}[$__rate_interval]))
+
sum by(pod) (rate(mongodb_metrics_queryExecutor_scannedObjects{pod=~"$Replica"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.description: See which node is currently acting as the primary, secondary, ...

targets.expr:
# https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/reference/replica-states/
sum by(member_idx) (mongodb_members_state{pod=~"$Replica", rs_state="1"})
or
avg by(member_idx) (mongodb_members_state{pod=~"$Replica"})
